title: clinopodium gracile var. minimum
intro: Clinopodium gracile var. minimum, commonly known as Mountain Melissa, is a lesser-known variety of the Clinopodium genus, a group of flowering plants in the mint family. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium gracile var. minimum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm anxiety, and support respiratory health. Its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential to inhibit the growth of microorganisms and reduce inflammation.
